```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, error=FALSE, comment='', dpi=400)
library(dplyr)
library(flextable)

TeachingDemos::char2seed('rotherham')
n_sample = 40

# data from 5_read_pdf_files_to_xml_automate.R
load('data/5_automated.RData')
# data from 5_data_code_oddpub.R
load('data/5_oddpub.RData')
open_data_results = select(open_data_results, doi, is_open_data)
#
auto_data = full_join(auto_data, open_data_results, by = 'doi')
```

We randomly selected a subsample of `r n_sample` of the final data to manually verify the data entry and processing.

## Data from automation

```{r automation}
# sample and table
sample = sample_n(auto_data, n_sample) %>%
  select(doi, analysis_plan, ethics, equator, conflict, funding, registration, is_open_data) %>% # not using protocol because of polysemy
  mutate(supplement = '') # add column to assess if there was a supplement mentioned or not
ftab = flextable(sample) %>%
  theme_box() %>% 
  autofit()
ftab
```
